description: This Java class FileBasedConfigSupplier provides methods to load configuration data from a file specified by an environment variable or resource, with support for fallback configurations such as VCAP services and secrets.

classes.name: FileBasedConfigSupplier
classes.description: Provides configuration by loading a config file specified via environment variable or resource, with support for fallback configurations.

methods.name: forConfiguredConfigFile
methods.description: Creates a FileBasedConfigSupplier instance based on a file specified by an environment variable.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Creates a FileBasedConfigSupplier instance based on a resource file.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the configuration. Overrides Supplier's get method.
